backtest.disclaimer: A screen, not a success-probability model. The conversion sample is small and selection-biased (only pitchers teams chose to convert), so the weights are frozen priors from the literature and this rho is a directional sign-check, not a fitted validation. Success = held the new role at least one full season.

verdict.summary: A candidate SCREEN, not a success-probability model. 95 role conversions detected 2018-2026; pre-conversion FIT vs the held-the-role label sign-checks POSITIVE at Spearman rho 0.223 (n=44), and actual converters sit at the 72th percentile of the full-pool FIT distribution (teams convert arms the score ranks well). The sample is small and selection-biased (only pitchers teams chose to convert), so the weights are FROZEN literature priors and the backtest confirms sign only, never fits the weights. Ships provisional; the ML classifier is deferred (insufficient clean n). Success label = held the new role >=1 full season (objective, avoids the role-adjusted-tax circularity).
